proposals.old_text: Classify the input into exactly one of: urgent, billing, technical, feature, security, other.
proposals.new_text: Classify the input into one or more of: urgent, billing, technical, feature, security, other.
proposals.hypothesis: Allowing for multiple classifications will help the model capture cases where inputs can belong to more than one category, as seen in several traces where the expected output included multiple categories.
proposals.expected_improvement: This change should reduce the number of classification failures related to inputs that fit multiple categories.

proposals.expected_improvement: This change should help the model understand that it can output multiple categories, reducing misclassifications.
